item.name: Meera Mustard Zari-Yoke 3-Piece Suit Set
item.description: A regal mustard-olive 3-piece ethnic ensemble by Shruhi Collections (MRP ₹1,950 • Sizes M to 2XL). Features a richly embroidered square neckline yoke paired with sleek trousers and a statement ethnic-printed border dupatta.
item.material: Festive Silk Blend with Woven Dupatta

item.name: Astha Deep Maroon A-Line Tunic & Pant Set
item.description: Designed for refined evening poise by Shruhi Collections, the Astha ensemble (MRP ₹1,550 • Size L) pairs a flared A-line deep maroon kurti with tailored straight trousers. A contrasting lime-olive center yoke framed by antique gold geometric embroidery and a scalloped hemline lends heritage artistry.
item.material: Textured Chanderi / Slub Silk Blend

item.name: Lamex Bronze-Gold Scalloped Border Suit Set
item.description: From the Shruhi Collections festive line, Lamex (MRP ₹2,850 • Sizes M to 2XL) shimmers in an antique bronze-olive hue. Delicate silver-and-maroon floral embroidery graces the rounded neckline and cuffs, while a bold vertical row of circular floral medallions mirrors the scalloped border of the matching dupatta.
item.material: Lustrous Tissue-Silk Blend

item.name: Tejal Golden-Ochre V-Neck Palazzo Suit Set
item.description: Tejal by Shruhi Collections (MRP ₹3,550 • Sizes M to 2XL) reimagines festive dressing with a sweeping wide-leg palazzo silhouette in warm golden ochre. The V-neck tunic is highlighted by a central diamond-motif embroidered medallion, delicate all-over sequin buttis, and a scalloped dori-embroidered border.
item.material: Rich Shimmer Silk with Flowing Palazzo

item.name: Moni Pastel Sage & Ivory Scalloped Dupatta Suit
item.description: Showcased in two serene colourways—Mist Sage Green and Pearl Ivory—the Moni 3-piece suit set by Shruhi Collections (MRP ₹2,550 • Sizes M to 2XL) balances minimalist straight kurtis with opulent burgundy-and-plum embroidered neckline plackets, bold cuff borders, and an heirloom-inspired scalloped archway dupatta.
item.material: Soft Chanderi Cotton-Silk

item.name: D.No 1042 Olive & Bandhani Print Plus-Size Suit (2-Colour Series)
item.description: Crafted by Shruhi Collections in inclusive sizes 3XL to 5XL/6XL (MRP ₹2,550), Design No. 1042 pairs a rich olive-green straight kurta with matching trousers and a contrast dupatta in Teal Botanical Leaf (3XL–5XL) or Crimson Bandhani print (3XL–6XL).
item.color: Olive Green with Teal / Crimson Dupatta
item.material: Soft Viscose Silk with Printed Modal Dupatta

item.name: Kitty Party Mustard Collared Appliqué Co-ord Set
item.description: A conversation-starting contemporary co-ord set by Shruhi Collections (MRP ₹1,800 • Sizes L to 2XL). Tailored in earthy mustard-ochre, the collared button-down tunic features whimsical embroidered fashion-figure motifs along the lower hem and pairs effortlessly with matching straight-leg trousers.
item.material: Crisp Linen-Cotton Slub

item.name: Manika Berry-Mauve Mandala V-Neck Suit Set
item.description: Manika by Shruhi Collections (MRP ₹2,850 • Sizes M to 2XL) brings together a romantic berry-mauve palette and precision geometric threadwork. The V-neck kurta showcases a striking circular medallion and chevron collar detail, complemented by embroidered cuffs and a scalloped-edge dupatta.
item.material: Lustrous Modal / Roman Silk

item.name: Alkapuri Deep Wine Palazzo & Organza Dupatta Set
item.description: Understated luxury defines the Alkapuri deep wine 3-piece suit by Shruhi Collections (MRP ₹2,250 • Sizes M to 2XL). The straight-cut tunic features a refined silver-zari neckline and vertical placket with intricately worked sleeve cuffs, paired with relaxed wide-leg palazzos and a lightweight matching dupatta.
item.material: Roman Silk with Sheer Embroidered Dupatta

item.name: D.No 1038 Crimson Maroon Geometric Panel Plus-Size Suit
item.description: Engineered by Shruhi Collections to flatter curvy figures in sizes 3XL, 5XL, and 6XL (MRP ₹2,650), Design No. 1038 features a bold vertical center panel of heritage geometric tile print accented with real mirror-work highlights, matching trousers, and a full geometric-printed dupatta.
item.material: Premium Heavy Rayon / Silk Blend

item.name: Shruhi 4781 Ivory Floral Lace-Trim Peplum Tunic
item.description: Shruhi Code 4781 (MRP ₹1,550 • Sizes M to XL) is a breezy ivory floral fusion top crafted for effortless everyday styling. Features a front keyhole tie-up neckline, pintuck bodice detailing, wide white crochet lace borders at the cuffs and hem, and a detachable green braided waist cord.
item.material: Breathable Textured Cotton Lawn

item.name: Shruhi 5708 Cream & Dusty Rose Strappy Floral Co-ord Set
item.description: Channelling modern resort sophistication, Shruhi Code 5708 (MRP ₹1,750 • Sizes L, XL) pairs a cream strappy tunic—complete with adjustable tie-up shoulder straps and a central embroidered sunburst motif—with matching wide-leg trousers adorned in climbing dusty-rose chrysanthemum blooms.
item.material: Lightweight Linen-Viscose Blend

item.name: Valentina Jamun-Magenta Patola Dupatta Suit Set
item.description: Valentina by Shruhi Collections (MRP ₹2,550 • Size L) celebrates Gujarat-inspired textile heritage with a rich jamun-magenta straight kurta framed by vertical printed borders, fine pintuck pleats, and diamond mirror-work motifs down the center. Paired with matching cigarette pants and a Patola-style dupatta.
item.material: Lustrous Modal Silk with Woven-Look Printed Dupatta

item.name: Lock Espresso Brown Crimson-Moon & Deer Motif Suit Set
item.description: A standout artistic creation by Shruhi Collections in deep espresso brown, the Lock 3-piece suit set (MRP ₹2,350 • Size M) features a magenta-piped V-neckline, vertical silver leaf motifs, and a striking white stag silhouetted against a crimson moon near the hem.
item.material: Textured Tussar-Linen Silk Blend

item.name: Shruhi 5810 Jet-Black Paisley Border Midi Dress
item.description: Shruhi Code 5810 (MRP ₹1,450 • Sizes M to 2XL) is an effortless one-piece Indo-Western midi dress in classic jet black. Designed with a notched mandarin collar, wooden-style front buttons, three-quarter sleeves, and a braided tassel belt that cinches above a vivid multicolor paisley-embroidered hemline.
item.material: Soft Rayon Crepe

item.name: Shruhi B-2876 Burgundy Kashmiri-Floral Embroidered Co-ord
item.description: One of the most opulent ensembles in the Shruhi Collections lookbook, Code B-2876 (MRP ₹2,250 • Sizes 3XL to 5XL) in deep burgundy-maroon showcases lush multicolor floral vine embroidery across both the front and back curved hemline, sleeve cuffs, and wide-leg trouser ankles.
item.material: Premium Velvet-Touch / Heavy Roman Silk

item.name: Shruhi 5625 Midnight Navy & Crimson Botanical Short Kurti
item.description: Shruhi Code 5625 combines everyday comfort with rich heritage printmaking. Cut from breathable cotton in midnight navy layered with crimson, mustard, and sage foliage, this tailored hip-length tunic features a neat mandarin collar and three-quarter sleeves.
item.material: 100% Pure Cambric Cotton

item.name: Shruhi 5041 Dusty Plum Chevron Kaftan & Palazzo Co-ord
item.description: Effortless movement meets bohemian royalty in Shruhi Code 5041 (MRP ₹1,550 • Sizes L, XL). This two-piece kaftan co-ord set pairs a relaxed poncho-style V-neck top with sweeping wide-leg palazzos in dusty plum chevron bandhani print, accented by a vibrant turquoise-and-coral border.
item.material: Fluid Modal Satin / Muslin Silk

item.name: Anupama Cinnamon-Rust Embroidered Scallop Dupatta Suit
item.description: Tailored in a warm cinnamon-rust tone and available across an inclusive M to 5XL size range (MRP ₹2,550), Anupama-I features delicate silver-zari neckline embroidery, scattered motif buttis, and a matching dupatta framed by scalloped cutwork.
item.material: Lustrous Roman Silk with Scalloped Dupatta

item.name: Glory Taupe-Beige Organza Floral Dupatta Suit Set
item.description: From the Shruhi Collections Glory line (MRP ₹2,650, Sizes M to 2XL), this refined taupe-beige 3-piece ensemble pairs a shimmering straight kurta featuring pearl-and-zari neckline embroidery with tailored trousers and a botanical-printed organza dupatta.
item.material: Soft Shimmer Silk with Printed Organza Dupatta

item.name: Galaxy Ivory & Royal Crimson Banarasi Silk Dupatta Suit
item.description: The crown jewel of the WhatsApp priced collection (MRP ₹3,550, Sizes M to 5XL), Galaxy contrasts a luminous pearl-ivory straight suit featuring a crimson-and-gold embroidered yoke against a richly woven heirloom crimson Banarasi silk dupatta.
item.material: Chanderi Silk Kurta with Heavy Woven Banarasi Dupatta

item.name: Shruhi 5601 Indigo Denim Button-Down Tiered Midi Dress
item.description: Shruhi Code 5601 (MRP ₹1,550, Sizes M to 2XL) brings contemporary western-fusion ease to the lookbook. Tailored in soft washed indigo denim chambray, it features a crisp shirt collar, cuffed 3/4 sleeves, and a gathered ombré-washed midi skirt tier.
item.material: Soft Washed Tencel-Denim Chambray

item.name: Shree Coffee-Brown Zari-Yoke Elegance 3-Piece Suit Set
item.description: From the Shruhi Shree Elegance series (MRP ₹2,550, Sizes M to 2XL), this deep coffee-brown 3-piece suit features an ornate antique-gold embroidered neckline yoke, scattered shimmer buttis, matching straight pants, and a tassel-trimmed sheer dupatta.
item.material: Lustrous Modal / Chanderi Silk

item.name: Anupama Pearl-Ivory Scalloped Dupatta Plus-Size Suit
item.description: The pearl-ivory counterpart in the Anupama curvy couture line (MRP ₹2,550, Sizes 3XL to 5XL). Features a refined silver-and-taupe embroidered rounded neckline, delicate front buttis, matching ivory trousers, and a statement scalloped cutwork dupatta.
item.material: Lustrous Roman Silk with Scalloped Dupatta

item.name: D.No 1002 Mustard-Gold Geometric Yoke Plus-Size Palazzo Set
item.description: Design No. 1002 in Mustard Gold (MRP ₹1,500, Sizes 3XL & 4XL) is a smart two-piece plus-size kurta and palazzo set featuring a striking black-and-maroon geometric embroidered bib yoke, matching geometric sleeve cuffs, and relaxed wide-leg palazzo bottoms.
item.material: Heavy Slub Rayon / Cotton Silk

item.name: D.No 1002 Ivory & Rust Geometric Yoke Plus-Size Palazzo Set
item.description: Design No. 1002 in Cream Ivory (MRP ₹1,500, Sizes 3XL to 5XL) pairs a breezy ivory straight kurta featuring a bold rust-and-maroon geometric embroidered center yoke and matching sleeve cuffs with flowing wide-leg ivory palazzo trousers.
item.material: Heavy Slub Rayon / Cotton Silk

item.name: Shruhi 5795 Crimson & Beige Kalamkari Floral Midi Dress
item.description: Shruhi Code 5795 (MRP ₹1,350, Size L) is a sun-drenched A-line midi dress crafted in breathable cotton with an all-over crimson-and-beige botanical floral print, notched lapel collar, fitted waist pleats, and roll-tab three-quarter sleeves.
item.material: 100% Pure Soft Cambric Cotton

item.name: Shruhi 5620 Multicolor Abstract Marble-Swirl Short Tunic
item.description: Shruhi Code 5620 (MRP ₹850, Sizes M to 2XL) is a contemporary hip-length tunic top featuring an artistic watercolor swirl and foliage print in muted sage, mauve, navy, and gold, finished with a mandarin collar and button placket.
item.material: Soft Viscose Lawn / Muslin Blend

item.name: Kavya Dusty-Mauve Cutwork Hem & Ivory Organza Dupatta Suit
item.description: Kavya by Shruhi Collections (MRP ₹2,850, Sizes S, L, 2XL) pairs a dusty mauve-taupe straight kurta featuring geometric V-neck embroidery and an intricate cutwork border hemline with wide-leg palazzos and a contrasting pearl-ivory scalloped organza dupatta.
item.material: Textured Chanderi Silk with Scalloped Organza Dupatta
